capture: Kit B HDMI, 1920x1080 at 60 fps, scaled to 480x270 gray; frame numbers count from the capture's start
enter_frame: first frame after Enter that changes by more than a cursor blink (12 px): the prompt's cursor drops a line or the screen clears
pm_frame: last frame that changes by more than 0.05% of the picture: Program Manager fully drawn, then the screen is still to the end of the capture

runs.boot: first win after DOS boot, temporary swap file
second win, same DOS session, temporary swap file
win from DOS after the permanent swap file was made, 32-bit disk access in use
